title: EEF-video VLM review answer (eef-review/1.1)
description: What the model returns for one review window (design doc 12 §10.2, D-E14): one point P and at most one axis A per window. Classes only: no pixel, millimetre or angle values. evidence_frame_ids must be frame ids shown in the request (checked by the runner, not by this Schema). 1.1: background_motion_support dropped (the model cannot judge camera motion from a few crops).

review_status.description: Repeats position_support: is the red circle P on the point P it defines?

target_visible.description: The gripper and the defined point are visible in most frames of the window

tracking_target_correct.description: The independent observation (green cross P) sits on P, not on another object

position_support.description: support: the red circle P is on the defined point P; refute: it is visibly off

orientation_support.description: support: the red arrow A points the way A of the gripper does; not_observable when no arrow is drawn

explanation.description: Short reason in words; measured values (px, mm, cm, degrees) are refused by the runner
